summary.text: Kelly Ayotte is the incumbent Republican governor, first elected in 2024. A former New Hampshire attorney general (2004–2009) and U.S. senator (2011–2017), she has signed legislation rolling back parts of the state's 2018 bail reform law, banning municipal sanctuary policies, and removing the income cap on Education Freedom Accounts, and signed a budget without new taxes but with fee increases.

paragraphs.text: Born in Nashua; graduated from Penn State and Villanova University School of Law; worked as a law clerk, prosecutor and deputy attorney general.
Served as New Hampshire's 27th attorney general, 2004–2009, the first woman in that role, then as U.S. senator, 2011–2017; elected governor in 2024.
